subject: general
question: One pipe can fill the tank in 20 min while another pipe can empty it in 60 min. If both the pipes are operated together, how long will it take to fill the tank completely?
solution:
Given:

A pipe can fill a tank in 20 minutes. Another pipe can empty that tank in 60 minutes

Calculation:

Let the volume of the tank be 60 liters (L.C.M of 20 and 60)

Part filled in 1 min = 60/20

⇒ 3 liters

Part emptied in 1 min = 60/60

⇒ 1 liters

Part filled in 1 mins = (3 - 1) = 2 litre

Time taken to fill 60 liters = 60/2 = 30 mins

∴ The time taken to fill the tank is 30 mins.
